title: Compose the Policy Digest PDF content widget
prompt: Build the widgets.json for "Surveillance Data" at http://localhost:7807. It has exactly one entry, `policy_digest_pdf`: name "Policy Digest PDF", description "Current surveillance policy digest.", endpoint /policy-digest-pdf, type pdf, sized w=16 h=14 on the grid, category "Surveillance", source "/policy/digest.pdf"; it caches results for 30 minutes. Time-based config converts to milliseconds: "cache results for N minutes" means staleTime N*60000; "auto-refresh every N seconds" means refetchInterval N*1000.. Then add the backend.
novelty: Unique types/t2 building exercise using get_workspace_snapshot, manage_backends with checks repeated_snapshots, too_many_invalid_calls, widget_def on custom:Surveillance Data; artifact widgetdefs:Surveillance Data/policy_digest_pdf.
